definition: to officially join a course, program or school
vi: ghi danh, đăng ký nhập học (khóa học)
example: I plan to enroll in an evening payroll course at a local college this fall.

definition: money paid for being taught at a school, college or university
example: International students pay much higher tuition fees than domestic students.

definition: money given to a student to help pay for education, often for good results
example: My nephew received a scholarship that covers half of his first-year tuition.

definition: a course or condition you must complete before you can do something else
vi: điều kiện tiên quyết, môn học bắt buộc trước
example: Introductory Accounting is a prerequisite for the Intermediate Accounting course.

definition: qualifications or documents that prove your education or skills
vi: bằng cấp, chứng chỉ (chứng minh trình độ)
example: Many immigrants must have their foreign credentials assessed before working in their field.

definition: to improve your abilities, especially through training
example: Taking an online Excel course is an easy way to upgrade your skills in the evenings.
collocations: a chance to upgrade your skills

definition: classes for adults who have finished their basic schooling
vi: giáo dục thường xuyên, chương trình học cho người lớn
example: The college's continuing education department offers part-time courses in project management.

definition: a course you take over the internet
example: An online course lets me study after my kids go to bed.

definition: a piece of work given to a student
example: The final assignment is due on December 5 and is worth 30 percent of the grade.

definition: extra time given to finish work after the original due date
example: I asked my instructor for a deadline extension because I was sick for a week.

definition: a meeting between a parent and a teacher to discuss a child's progress
vi: buổi họp phụ huynh với giáo viên
example: At the parent-teacher conference, the teacher said my son needs more help with reading.

definition: activities such as sports or clubs done outside regular classes
example: Extracurricular activities like soccer and band help children build confidence.

definition: all the subjects and content taught in a school or course
example: Many parents want financial literacy to be part of the high school curriculum.

definition: a short course of study that gives a certificate rather than a degree
vi: chương trình đào tạo cấp chứng chỉ
example: She completed an eight-month certificate program in supply chain management.

definition: a period of training where you learn a trade while working
example: He started an electrical apprenticeship after finishing high school.

definition: an official record of a student's courses and grades
example: The college asked me to submit an official transcript from my university in Vietnam.

definition: a staff member who helps students plan their courses
example: My academic advisor suggested taking two courses per term while working full-time.

definition: to leave school or a course before finishing it
example: He had to drop out of the program when his work hours changed.

definition: to fail to keep up with work or with others
vi: bị tụt lại phía sau, chậm tiến độ
example: If you miss more than two classes, it's easy to fall behind.

definition: to do things you did not have time to do earlier
vi: bắt kịp, làm bù (việc bị bỏ lỡ)
example: I spent Sunday catching up on the readings I missed last week.

definition: the time and effort needed to learn a new skill or system
vi: quá trình làm quen, độ khó khi học cái mới
example: The new accounting software has a steep learning curve, but it saves time later.

definition: lessons where students and teacher are physically in the same room
example: Some students prefer in-person classes because they can ask questions easily.

definition: education after high school, such as college or university
vi: sau trung học (cao đẳng, đại học)
example: Many BC high school graduates go on to post-secondary education.

definition: money borrowed to pay for education, paid back later
example: It took her eight years to pay off her student loan.

definition: a visit away from school for students to learn something
vi: chuyến tham quan học tập, dã ngoại
example: The Grade 4 class went on a field trip to the aquarium in Stanley Park.

definition: a private teacher who teaches one student or a small group
example: We hired a math tutor to help our daughter prepare for her final exams.

definition: abilities that are useful in real situations
example: Employers often value practical skills more than high grades.

definition: a small group of students who meet to study together
example: Joining a study group helped me stay motivated during my CPA courses.

definition: to complete a course of study at a school or university
example: She graduated from Simon Fraser University with a degree in business.

definition: being present at classes, work or an event
vi: sự có mặt, sự chuyên cần
example: Attendance is mandatory for the first two classes of the program.

definition: a written report from a school about a student's grades and behaviour
vi: phiếu báo điểm, sổ liên lạc
example: Parents receive a report card at the end of each term.

definition: one of the two or three periods that a school or college year is divided into
example: I am taking three courses this semester while working part-time.

definition: to give a piece of work to a teacher or person in authority
example: All assignments must be handed in by Friday at noon.

definition: the first year of school, for children around five years old
vi: lớp mẫu giáo (năm đầu tiên ở trường tiểu học, cho trẻ khoảng 5 tuổi)
example: Our son starts kindergarten in September at the school down the street.

definition: a book that contains detailed information about a subject for students
example: Used textbooks are often much cheaper than new ones at the campus bookstore.

definition: a person who is in the same class as you at school
example: I practised my presentation with a classmate before class.

definition: the pens, notebooks and other items students need for school
example: Stores are busy in late August when families shop for school supplies.

definition: to study a subject in an organized class
example: I decided to take a course in bookkeeping at the community college.

definition: to spend time learning in order to prepare for a test or exam
vi: ôn thi, học để chuẩn bị (cho kỳ thi)
example: She studied for the exam every evening for two weeks.

definition: to not go to a class when you should
example: Students who skip class often fall behind quickly.

definition: the last and usually most important exam at the end of a course
example: The final exam is worth forty percent of your grade.

definition: an area with its own group of public schools managed together
vi: khu học chánh, sở giáo dục khu vực
example: Our school district announced that classes will start a day later because of the snow.

definition: to improve a skill or knowledge you had but have partly forgotten
example: I need to brush up on my math before I start the nursing program.

definition: to officially stop taking a course before it ends
vi: rút khỏi môn học, bỏ môn
example: If you drop a course before the deadline, you may get part of your tuition back.
collocations: drop a course before the deadline

definition: a student who takes a full program of courses
example: As a full-time student, she has little time left for a part-time job.

definition: an average of a student's marks, used to measure academic performance
example: Some programs only accept applicants with a high grade point average.

definition: the conditions you must meet to be accepted into a school or program
example: Check the admission requirements carefully before you apply to the program.

definition: an exam taken in the middle of a school term
example: I did poorly on the midterm, so I joined a study group.

definition: a school assignment that several students work on together
vi: dự án nhóm, bài tập nhóm
example: Our group project was hard because one member never answered messages.

definition: the elected group of people who make decisions about local public schools
vi: hội đồng giáo dục (cấp khu học chánh)
example: Parents spoke at the school board meeting about overcrowded classrooms.

definition: a public school program in which students whose first language is not French learn many or most subjects in French
vi: chương trình học hòa nhập tiếng Pháp (học các môn bằng tiếng Pháp)
example: We enrolled our daughter in French immersion so she could grow up speaking both official languages.

definition: an official document that allows a person from another country to study in Canada
example: She applied for a study permit after she was accepted by a college in Victoria.

definition: a program in which students alternate classroom study with paid work in their field
vi: chương trình học kết hợp thực tập có lương
example: The co-op program helped him get a full-time job right after graduation.

definition: to learn how to do something after some practice
vi: nắm được cách làm, quen tay
example: The new online learning platform was confusing at first, but it did not take long to get the hang of it.
collocations: start to get the hang of

definition: a person, often a graduate student, who helps a professor or teacher by marking work and leading smaller classes
example: If you have questions about the assignment, email the teaching assistant.

definition: the times when a teacher or professor is available to meet students
example: My instructor holds office hours every Tuesday afternoon.

definition: a document showing that you have completed a course of study, often shorter than a degree
vi: văn bằng, bằng tốt nghiệp (cao đẳng)
example: He earned a two-year diploma in early childhood education.

definition: a university degree usually taking three or four years to complete
example: She completed her bachelor's degree in Vietnam and now wants to study in Canada.

definition: the number of courses or the amount of work a student takes in a term
example: Because of her job, she reduced her course load to two classes.

definition: an adult student who returns to education after some years away
vi: sinh viên lớn tuổi, người đi học lại
example: As a mature student, he brought valuable work experience to the class.

definition: a period of supervised practical work that is part of a training program
vi: kỳ thực tập (bắt buộc trong chương trình)
example: Nursing students complete a practicum at a local hospital.

definition: copying someone else's work or ideas and presenting them as your own
example: The instructor reminded us that plagiarism can lead to failing the course.

definition: to mention where you found information you use in your work
example: You must cite your sources in every research essay.

definition: continuing to learn new skills and knowledge throughout your life
example: The library promotes lifelong learning with free classes for adults of all ages.

definition: to pass a test very easily and with a high mark
vi: đỗ với điểm số rất cao, đậu xuất sắc
example: After months of practice, she passed her driver's knowledge test with flying colours.
collocations: pass the exam with flying colours

definition: a person's level of skill in a language
example: Many colleges ask international students to prove their language proficiency.

definition: a staff member who helps teachers support students, especially those with extra needs
vi: trợ lý giáo dục, trợ giảng hỗ trợ học sinh
example: The education assistant works one-on-one with two students in my son's class.

definition: a condition that makes it harder for a person to learn certain skills, such as reading
vi: khuyết tật học tập, khó khăn trong học tập
example: Teachers received extra training to support students with a learning disability.

definition: a program that helps people trained in another country meet local standards for their profession
vi: chương trình chuyển tiếp (công nhận nghề cho người nhập cư)
example: The bridging program helped her return to her career as a pharmacist in Canada.
collocations: bridging program for internationally trained professionals

definition: honesty and fairness in schoolwork, such as not cheating or copying
example: All students must complete a short course on academic integrity in their first term.

definition: the ability to read a text and understand its meaning
example: Reading the news every day can improve your reading comprehension.

definition: to keep information in your memory
example: Students tend to retain information better when they explain it to someone else.

definition: learning by repeating something many times rather than by understanding it
example: Many educators argue that rote learning does not teach students how to solve real problems.

definition: testing in which all students answer the same questions and are marked in the same way
example: Some parents believe there is too much emphasis on standardized testing in schools.

definition: officially approved as meeting the required standards
vi: được công nhận, được kiểm định
example: Before paying, make sure the college is accredited and its credits can be transferred.

definition: the ability to think carefully about information and judge it fairly
example: Good teachers encourage critical thinking, not just memorizing facts.

definition: how interested and involved students are in their learning
vi: mức độ tham gia, gắn kết của học sinh
example: Smaller classes and hands-on activities can increase student engagement.
